en.topic_title: Hong Kong private hospital apologises after doctor mistakenly removed patient’s ovaries during operation
en.topic_summary:
A private hospital has apologised to a patient and her family after a doctor mistakenly removed a woman’s ovaries during an operation.



CUHK Medical Centre. Photo: 水浪/Google Maps.



Chung Kin-lai, chief executive officer of the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) Medical Centre, said during a press conference on Wednesday that the doctor involved was an experienced contract obstetrician and gynaecologist resident.



The doctor admitted the incident was due to mistakes during a phone
